# Security verdict: #313 at 8dd610594a1194320106f15233242e8764870b35 — PASS WITH NOTES

Scope: diff origin/main(7a6b8cbc)...8dd6105 (9 files). Merge commit only folds #312; no conflict residue. No lockfile, .npmrc, refs/notes, credential or launch changes. Secret/home-path scan of the diff: empty.

## Q1. Can the skip let an injection or /restart type into a draft the observer no longer sees? No.
Every production pane-typing site goes through `InteractionGate::submit_with_owned_input` (delivery/mod.rs:1550, pointer/worker.rs:522/620/706, cheap_return.rs:204), which calls `injection_observation` twice (look, then again under acquired input) and types only when THAT capture's `composer_idle` is true. `injection_observation` drains the tap, lists panes and captures itself (interaction.rs:557ff); `composer_idle` comes from that capture alone. Socket delivery (delivery/mod.rs:1911) and F212 auth-recovery `composer_free` (auth_recovery.rs:334, needs permitted && composer_idle) also use `fresh_injection_verdict`. The non-fresh `permits_injection` has no production caller (grep: tests only). No production code reads `observed()` or observer knowledge for a decision except `replay()` itself.
Where stale observer state does reach the fresh path it only brakes: a fresh recognised capture that differs from a stale held composer sets `last_edit_at = now` → HumanTyping deferral (later, never earlier); an Unrecognised fresh capture sets uncertainty now → `permits_with_additional_veto(.., true)` returns false. Removing the replay makes the gate see no fewer drafts at the boundary: the skip is not a policy input to typing.
Mutation: M4 (fresh verdict answers from held state) RED per PR comment 7059426240 — matches my reading of the witness test.

## Q2. Can a pane's own output make the observer replay a stale Blank? Not past the boundary.
A pane cannot hide output from `pipe-pane -O` short of driving tmux itself (same user; it could equally send-keys — not a trust boundary the gate claims). Typing moves the cursor (forces capture); tap bytes force capture; knowledge Unknown/PendingClear never replays; observer capture/drain errors `set_unknown` (gate uncertain → no replay). Worst case is observer-side staleness ≤ CAPTURE_BACKSTOP (30 s, M3 RED), and the boundary re-captures regardless.

## Prime's checks
1. Injection takes its own capture: yes (above).
2. Replay ageing: `decide` is the old loop body moved verbatim; replay passes tap_active=false as a repeat capture of an unchanged screen did. Twin-observer test + M5/M6 RED.
3. Backstop: `now - last.at >= 30 s` → BackstopDue → capture; M3 RED.

## Notes (non-blocking; correctness, not security — none reaches a typing decision)
- S313-N1: the "gate still holds that composer" guard in `replay()` has no witness. No test runs an observer pass AFTER a fresh injection changed the gate (the injection test asserts and stops). Mutant `holds = true` would, by reading, stay green; its effect would be a stale Blank replay calling `record_composer_cleared` over a draft the fresh capture recorded — the next fresh capture then defers as HumanTyping, so it only brakes. Suggest one assertion: after `permits_injection_fresh` sees the draft, one more observer pass captures (not replays).
- S313-N2: two staleness windows the doc comment does not cover: (a) `injection_observation` drains the tap, then a `list_panes`/`capture` Err returns with the gate unchanged and certain (the comment says "when it could not read the screen, the gate is uncertain" — true only for Unrecognised, not for Err); (b) `attach_pane_tap` returning Ok on an already-tracked pane (a vanished pipe repaired, e.g. after respawn-pane or a foreign `pipe-pane` toggle) does not clear `last`, so bytes written while the pipe was gone are lost and the pane may replay until cursor/tap/backstop. Both bounded by 30 s and fresh at the boundary. Optional: clear `last` on a repaired attach.
